title: Shenango Valley — Meet David
heygenScriptShort: Welcome to Shenango Valley. I'm David — your local guide. We'll start at Buhl Park in Hermitage, swing past the New Wilmington Amish countryside, then hit two valley tables: Quaker Steak and Lube in Sharon, and Luigi's Pizza. Ask me anything, or open the atlas and pick a pin.
